flags.t: Region 4: it is unlawful to feed or bait deer, elk, moose and other hoofed game, or turkeys, anywhere in the Kootenay Region (synopsis page 37, 99%). Snowmobiles may not be used for hunting in Region 4 from 1 April to 30 November (page 37, 99%).

plan: Drive: from Town of Golden, about 34 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate). Via Hwy 1 (Trans-Canada Hwy E), Golden Donald Upper Rd, Moberly School Rd, Blaeberry Rd. Official directions to Split Creek rec site: Access Blaeberry Forest Service Road from the Trans Canada Highway just North of Golden, using either Hartley Rd or Moberly Branch Rd.
